coupling: The alignment commit makes EXPAT_MALLOC_PADDING nonzero on the target by including long double in the alignment union. The later realloc hardening commit removes EXPAT_MALLOC_PADDING from the realloc size while the returned pointer is still advanced past sizeof(size_t) + EXPAT_MALLOC_PADDING. Either edit alone preserves the old allocation capacity: alignment-only keeps the padding in the realloc size, and realloc-only has zero padding on the original alignment union. Only their composition under-allocates grown blocks by the padding width. A correct fix must reconcile the allocation size and pointer offset across both commits; changing either one alone removes the overflow.
